Posterior distribution of the event time at a landmark

Source: R/performanceInterval.R
event_time_posterior.Rd

For the model-based performance measures: each patient's distribution of \(T\) (and event type) given their history up to the landmark \(s\) and \(T > V\), their last visit – the same quantity predictRisk() integrates – tabulated on the cells of predictRisk()'s grids: \((V, s]\) (interval_gap_grid()) and \((s, upper]\) (prepare_infinity_grid()).

Usage

event_time_posterior(
  data_predict_all,
  long_fit_all,
  survival_fit_all,
  s,
  time_variable,
  survival_variable_all,
  survival_trans_function,
  n_inf = 100,
  n_gap = 20
)

Arguments

data_predict_all

Landmark data (history up to s).

long_fit_all, survival_fit_all

The fitted sub-models.

s

The landmark.

time_variable, survival_variable_all, survival_trans_function

As for predictRisk().

n_inf, n_gap

Grid cells after and before s.

Value

A named list (patient ids) of lists with edges (cell boundaries, from \(V\)) and mass (cells x event types, summing to 1).
